Lottie Murphy Videos by Phase

Phase 1 — Foundation

Build the habit. Keep it gentle. Focus on form and breathing.

20 min · Beginner · Full Body
Strong Dynamic Pilates Routine
Great starter — solid intro to Lottie's style.
20 min · Beginner · Full Body
20-Min Full Body Pilates to Tone
Good for establishing rhythm.
15 min · Beginner · Back Care
Pilates for Low Back Love
Builds good habits early even if back feels fine.
15 min · Beginner · Reset
Pilates for When You Need to Reset
Feel-good pace. Perfect for low energy days.
Phase 2 — Building

Step up duration. Introduce back-specific work. Start pushing slightly.

30 min · Intermediate · Full Body
30 Min Full Body Pilates | Soft Strength
Excellent quality. Good bridge from 20 to 30 min.
30 min · Intermediate · Full Body
30 Min Pilates Routine — Calm & Connected
Strong core focus. Accessible at your level.
30 min · Intermediate · Back
Pilates for Lower Back Pain
Spine-friendly. Specifically for back recovery.
15 min · All Levels · Neck
Wake Up Your Posture (with Weights)
Cervical stenosis friendly. Focus on alignment.
Phase 3 — Strengthening

Push consistently. Mix core-focused and full-body sessions. Track how you feel.

30 min · Intermediate · Full Body
Ultimate Pilates Toning Workout
Benchmark workout — good to measure progress against.
30 min · Intermediate · Core
30 Min Pilates Routine | Feel Good Feel Calm
Strong core work without overdoing it.
30 min · Intermediate · Mobility
Mobility Pilates Flow | 30 Min
Mid-week variety. Combines mobility + strength.
20 min · All Levels · Morning
Morning Pilates | 7 Moves to Start Your Day
Spine mobility heavy. Good for variety.

Daily Non-Negotiables

Morning stretch (in bed)
Hydration check (clear urine)
Salt water gargle
Electrolytes on workout days
Foam roll after activity
Epsom bath on Saturdays
Track energy level (1-10)
Track back pain (1-10)
Rest between sessions — Listen to your body — No grinding through pain — Progress over perfection
